answer: The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in orchard, expire in ridge, and shale lists each expiry. Someone running 41 aliases thus needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 604 identities would post 4882 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
